Reaching an unmodelable or tail member trips the BmcUnmodelledReached sentinel, so the verdict is an honest member-named **UNKNOWN** (a bmc4j model gap), never a false REFUTED and never a silent havoc — unless explicitly acknowledged via `acknowledgeUnmodelled`, which degrades it to a footnoted nondet stub.
